messages:
sam.w: quick check — streaming connections from node-sdk keep dropping when we use impersonation via OIDC (service account exchange). getting 401s with an aud mismatch in the gateway logs. anyone seen this exact behavior?

ana.k: can you paste the log line? aud mismatch usually means the id_token audience isn't the inference API. streaming expects an id_token with aud=https://inference.redwood.ai/ not a service-account email.

sam.w: log snippet:
```
[stream] connection closed: code=401 msg=unauthorized auth_error=invalid_token detail=expected aud=\"https://inference.redwood.ai/\", got \"impersonator@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"
```

max_r: aha. are you exchanging a JWT for an id_token or just using an access_token? Node SDK sometimes uses access tokens by default if you call .getAccessToken(). Streaming requires an id_token (OIDC) with the correct audience.

sam.w: repro steps: create impersonation SA, call iamcredentials:generateIdToken with target_audience unset (oops), then pass token into sdk.connect(). Node SDK v2.1.0. quick curl I used for exchange:
```
curl -s -X POST https://oauth.redwood.ai/token \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\" \
  -d 'grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer&assertion=<signed-jwt>' \
  -d 'audience=https://inference.redwood.ai/'
```
(note: this is a simplified example)

ana.k: if you're using iamcredentials.generateIdToken, set the audience param to the inference API URL. For Google-like flows use target_audience or include the audience claim in the signed JWT before exchange. Also confirm you're passing the token as an ID token in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer <id_token>` not as an access token for OAuth resource.

max_r: in the Node client we added a helper that sets the right aud when you call client.auth.getIdToken({audience}), but only if you instantiate auth with {impersonate: true}. Before we had a bug where impersonation returned the service-account email as aud. We patched it in a small patch (internal PR 4123).

sam.w: that matches — I was on master before the patch. workaround: set REDWOOD_IDTOKEN_AUD=https://inference.redwood.ai/ in env to force the right aud while we roll the patch. Will open a minimal PR to update our sample and add a test. pinging @ana.k for quick review.

devex-bot: FYI: auth/impersonation.md was edited 2 days ago (docs change by rachel) — might be worth syncing examples. :eyes:

ana.k: I'll take a look in ~30m. short checklist: 1) confirm id_token vs access_token, 2) ensure generateIdToken/audience param set, 3) check SDK version (>=2.1.1 includes the fix), 4) add an integration test that does a fake iam creds exchange in CI.

max_r: one more thing — if the stream disconnects mid-KV cache, we should attempt token refresh + resume rather than dropping the user's session. filing an eng-runtime ticket after your PR would be great.

sam.w: thanks — will send PR and link the runtime ticket. :thumbsup:

ana.k: thanks — will review and add test notes once PR is up.
